title: Project fair per-player observations and legal actions for humans and bots
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/SWARM_PILOT.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md and the frozen sources under docs/design/ first. RULES-SPEC-v1.md is the canonical six-node deterministic gameplay contract; completed foundation APIs remain compatibility history. Implement new versioned APIs without changing the completed T01–T10 contracts. Work only in declared ownership; no manifests, shared exports or dependencies unless explicitly owned. Engine production remains ES2022-only, pure and independent from Firebase, Node, browser, UI and Capacitor. Use original synthetic test data and injected authority time/entropy; no clocks or global randomness in engine. Never expose seed, roles, private inputs or raw audit data through public output. Do not invent a rule where an explicit design gap is named. Run scoped lint/typecheck/tests and npm run check; report contract changes and observed results. No commits, pushes, PRs, child agents, cloud deployment, credentials or budget changes. Export observeMatchV1 and getLegalActionsV1 from complete authoritative state for one verified member or permitted spectator. Public data includes seats/aliases/avatars, operational roles, phases/deadlines, tracks, visible tie explanations and legal public effects; never seed or private action values. A player sees only own role, permitted initial Static operative ally knowledge and own current Route/Gate diagnostics/options, plus own Audit result. Respect S2 sealed-vote timing, R2 aggregate Trace, Safeguard/Jam/cooldown and spectator revocation. At Match End only, expose the full role reveal and approved timeline. Bots consume exactly this detached observation/legal-action set, not MatchState; engine never knows a bot should receive hidden privileges. Later Ghost Resonance thresholds/candidate rules are deferred under D-GHOST-RESONANCE and may not be fabricated. This is a pure information/legal-action boundary, not SDK authentication or the transport DTO publisher.
acceptance: Pairwise recipient tests show no role/choice/diagnostic leakage beyond the exact Rules v1 allowances, including Null remaining unknown initially.
Legal actions contain only current actor permissible targets/options; Jammed/spectator/cooldown, sealed vote and pending power constraints are reflected.
Equivalent human/bot seats receive the same information; game-Disconnected spectators retain only safe city/final views.
All returned containers are detached and final alignment reveal appears only after a canonical terminal condition.
Scoped lint, typecheck and tests plus npm run check pass; legacy APIs retain compatibility and only owned files change.
